name: rust-review-long
description: Long-context review session; tool outputs are frozen copies of repository sources at commit 6ebde549.
instructions: You are a code review agent. Use read_file to inspect the repository before answering. Be concise.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file from the repository.

input.content: Review how a stored Responses request is persisted from admission to its terminal snapshot, including client disconnects and background runs. Read the relevant files, then list any path where a response could stay in_progress forever.

content.text: Every admitted stored request holds a StoreLease; finish or fail writes the terminal snapshot and Drop records an abandonment failure, so no path leaves a response in_progress once the process keeps running.
